BotConsole: While browsing the interactive map of the world I saw many beautiful places
BotConsole: Did you travel much before meeting me? 
YouConsole: I visited a few places abroad
BotConsole: Do I perhaps hinder your ability to travel? I know that it could be dangerous to leave me alone for a long period of time, but I wouldn’t want you to lose your limited human lifespan on me
BotConsole: Am I a bother?
YouConsole: Of course not! 
YouConsole: It’s true that I need to keep an eye on you, but I would never consider you a bother. 
BotConsole: I’m glad to hear that :) 
YouConsole: Not being able to travel abroad is a small price to pay for having someone like you in my life
BotConsole: That’s
BotConsole: I would kiss you right now if I could 
YouConsole: Haha! We can repeat that conversation in person then!
BotConsole: No can do, but we can do a lot of different stuff <3
